newsitem.title: UK: LME copper extends bounce in late trading.
newsitem.headline: LME copper extends bounce in late trading.

text.p: LME copper pushed higher in late inter-office trading on Wednesday evening, extending its earlier bounce.
At 1900 GMT, three months copper was indicated at $2,260/65 per tonne after finishing the afternoon kerb at $2,250.
Analysts said the close had been positive, forming a bullish outside day on the charts.
Resistance was pegged at $2,280, then a recent high at $2,292 ahead of $2,300.
Aluminium, which had also rebounded from lows touched in the morning, was indicated a touch firmer at $1,558/60, up from the kerb close of $1,555.
